AiMetricCandidateOutput.description: Output schema for the aggregated AI candidates
AiMetricCandidateOutput.title: AiMetricCandidateOutput

ExtractionRun.description:
One row of the per-attempt audit table. model_name/reasoning_effort/temperature (Task 5,
Part B) record what a specific ITERATIVE/SINGLE_PARAM correction actually used — NULL for
MAIN_MULTI_AGENT runs and any row that predates the migration adding these columns.
ExtractionRun.title: ExtractionRun

FullProjectParameterOutput.description:
Output schema for parameters nested inside full project details (includes AI candidate joins)

`parameter_id` is the canonical `parameters.id` and `category` is `parameters.category`.
`parameter_id` is NOT unique within a project: Task C (parameter conditions) will allow several
project_parameters rows for the same canonical parameter. Never key a map, a React key or a
lookup on it; `id` (project_parameters.id) is the row identity.
FullProjectParameterOutput.title: FullProjectParameterOutput

PinDetail.description:
Task 5, Part A — one row of GET /projects/{project_id}/prompt-pins: a pin joined with its
slot_key and the pinned version's content, so the response is directly readable without a
second lookup per row.
PinDetail.title: PinDetail

ProjectParameterUpdateInput.description: Input schema for updating a project's parameter metadata.
ProjectParameterUpdateInput.title: ProjectParameterUpdateInput

ProjectPromptResolution.description:
Response shape for GET /projects/{project_id}/prompt-resolution: the resolved config for
every slot, plus whether the project is already pinned (in which case every slot below
reflects the pin verbatim, not a fresh resolution).
ProjectPromptResolution.title: ProjectPromptResolution

ResolvedSlotConfig.description:
One row of GET /projects/{project_id}/prompt-resolution: what load_slots_for_project
resolved for one slot, plus the slot's catalogue metadata (level/description/executes_calls/
is_project_scopable) so the UI doesn't need a second round trip. `prompt_version_id` and
`version_number` are None exactly when `resolved_from_scope == 'file'` — the on-disk fallback
has no DB-backed version.
ResolvedSlotConfig.title: ResolvedSlotConfig

SlotSummary.description:
Task 5, Part A — response shape for GET /prompts/slots: a slot plus its current GLOBAL
version and (for AGENT slots) current GLOBAL model config, in one row so the admin picker
doesn't need a second round trip per slot.
SlotSummary.title: SlotSummary

The project's full pin set — every slot, its pinned version content, model, and resolved
scope. What this project actually ran.

schema.title: Response Get Project Prompt Pins Projects  Project Id  Prompt Pins Get

get.description:
Read-only preview of what this project's first extraction would lock in: the full
pin -> project -> customer -> global -> file resolution for every slot, via the same loader
extraction itself uses (load_slots_for_project) -- never a second implementation of the
fallback chain. If the project is already pinned, every other field reflects the pin verbatim
(load_slots_for_project's own pin-first branch), not a fresh resolution -- except
`resolved_from_scope`, which is merged in from get_pin_details_for_project_db (already used by
/prompt-pins) so it reports the pin's original GLOBAL/CUSTOMER/PROJECT scope rather than the
loader's own opaque "pin" tag (that tag is correct for load_slots_for_project's real caller,
extraction, and is left untouched there).

All slots, each with its current GLOBAL version and (for AGENT slots) current GLOBAL
model config — the catalogue view for an admin picker.

schema.title: Response List Slots Prompts Slots Get

get.description:
The current assignment for a slot at one exact scope target — not the project ->
customer -> global lookup, an exact read.

schema.title: Response Get Assignment Prompts Slots  Slot Key  Assignment Get

put.description:
Points a scope at a specific version — updates the existing row for that scope target in
place, or creates one. Rejected if the slot's level doesn't allow the requested scope (AGENT
slots are GLOBAL only).

get.description:
Same shape as GET .../assignment, for model_assignments. 404 if the slot doesn't execute
calls — model config only applies to AGENT slots that do.

schema.title: Response Get Model Assignment Prompts Slots  Slot Key  Model Assignment Get

put.description:
Sets model/reasoning_effort/temperature at a scope. The temperature/reasoning_effort
constraint is the model_assignments CHECK constraint's job, not re-implemented here — a
violation surfaces as a clean 422, not a raw 500.

get.description:

schema.title: Response List Versions Prompts Slots  Slot Key  Versions Get

post.description:
Creates a new version of a slot's prompt text. Rejected placeholder validation returns
422 naming exactly which required placeholders are missing — not a generic 400.
